headline: OPERATOR LOG
subhead: This file is only available after hours.
lockedCopy: Most records are unavailable during standard business hours. Clock out to proceed.

blocks.title: The Day Job
blocks.body: During the day, the operator works inside a real manufacturing business. Marketing, systems, practical problems. Dealer communications, product presentation, internal tooling, websites that have to actually work when a sales rep needs them at 6am on a trade show floor.
A website is not a decoration. It is a machine people use when nobody has time to explain things twice.

blocks.title: The Night Shift
blocks.body: At night, the same problems get dragged into the Lemonteed lab and turned into websites, tools, dashboards, experiments, and occasionally cursed artifacts. The work is different. The discipline is the same.

blocks.title: Why Both
blocks.body: The 9-to-5 keeps the work grounded. Real business constraints, real deadlines, real users who do not care about your process. The off-clock work keeps the thinking alive. Neither one works without the other.

items.title: Manufacturing Brand Systems
items.description: Public-facing pages, dealer messaging, product presentation, and practical marketing systems built for a real industrial business.

items.title: Internal Tooling
items.description: Dashboards and internal tools that operators actually use. Designed for clarity, not aesthetics.

blocks.body: Static does not mean dead. It means controlled, fast, portable, and harder to break.
